entries.title: Floodland

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Floodland is documented on Steam as a Windows post-climate-collapse society-survival city-builder from Vile Monarch and Ravenscourt, released on November 15, 2022. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. The Windows PC release is therefore the complete route and the best archive capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release and use the latest patch before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release and the only sourced platform route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster, definitive edition, or platform-exclusive content exists.
